GoCrazy is a Pakistan's first group buying social commerce marketplace that's reinventing the way people play, shop, & socialize.

Our unique approach combines discovery-based social sharing, community group buying, a gamified shopping experience, and next-generation payment solutions. Leveraging learnings from China and LatAm, and the sizable WhatsApp community in South Asia, the platform offers differentiated logistics to lower income neighborhoods with the main goal of connecting consumers to amazing products at “crazy low prices”.

We are on the mission of eliminating barriers to traditional e-commerce to provide low-income populations in Pakistan and throughout the Southern Asian region with better access to affordable products.

Put more simply, it aims to provide a more inclusive eCommerce experience that pays producers more and “sells cheaper” to those who buy products via our gamified app, which connects consumers to the best prices through community group purchases. Our model is super impactful because like most of Southern Asia, Pakistan is largely unbanked or underbanked (3rd largest unbanked country). entity.name: Gijima Media
entity.description:
Gijima Media is a specialized media, research, and marketing company focused on the digital gaming and online entertainment industry in Asia. We help international companies understand complex local markets and build sustainable, trust-based growth, with a strong focus on Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia.

Our work sits at the intersection of research, content, localization, and commercial strategy. Rather than offering generic global solutions, we focus on how digital gaming actually functions on the ground in each market. This includes player behavior, cultural expectations, payment habits, platform trust, regulatory sensitivity, and long-term brand credibility.

Gijima Media was built by professionals with direct industry experience. Our team includes former operators, marketers, writers, translators, affiliate managers, and VIP specialists who have worked inside global gaming companies. Because of this background, we understand both the commercial pressure to grow and the long-term risks that come from poor localization, aggressive tactics, or misunderstanding local users.

Our market focus

Asia is not one market. Japan alone operates very differently from Western countries and even from neighboring Asian regions. Players have different expectations around trust, language, transparency, customer support, and brand behavior. Payments, device usage, and content preferences also vary widely.

Gijima Media helps companies navigate these differences. We provide local insight that goes beyond surface level data. Our work explains not only what is happening in the market, but why it is happening. This helps our partners make better decisions, avoid costly mistakes, and build strategies that are realistic for each region.

While Japan is a core focus, we also support projects across Korea and Southeast Asia. This includes market comparison, entry strategy, and regional expansion planning.
